=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  Line or code reference: lines 789-791 (_shell_line_credentials)
  PROBLEM: `_shell_line_credentials()` checks for `$(` but omits backtick substitutions, allowing some shell command lines with backticks to bypass withholding.
  WHY: With outer single quotes, backticks remain literal at the withholding check; generated command text can evade credential extraction and be posted unmasked.
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  Line or code reference: lines 245-247 (_SHELL_COMMAND_RUNNERS) and lines 926-931 (_command_line_credentials)
  PROBLEM: `_SHELL_COMMAND_RUNNERS` omits the shell builtins `source` and `.`.
  WHY: Process substitutions passed to those builtins are not withheld, so credentials in generated content can be exposed.
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Line or code reference: lines 637-640 and lines 657-671 (_segment_shape)
  PROBLEM: `_segment_shape()` can retain attached alphabetic command text as a raw flag instead of masking it.
  WHY: For forms such as `sh -cwhoami`, command text can remain visible in the command shape and issue title.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "runs code a command substitution builds (`bash -c "$(…)"`, `eval "$(…)"`, a substitution as the command word) ... is withheld and only its shape is posted" (PR description, agents.md lines 1154-1157, changelog.d/5124-mask-credentials-in-prompt-reports.md line 4)
  Expected change site: `_shell_line_credentials` in `.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py` and `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py`
  Evidence of absence: In `_shell_line_credentials()` (lines 789-790), the withholding check only inspects `if "$(" in line:` and does not test for backtick substitutions (``"`" in line``). Command lines passed to shell runners using outer single quotes (such as `bash -c '`printf %s "mysql -pS3cretPass"`'`, `eval '`printf ...`'`, `bash <<< '`cat script`'`) contain literal backticks and bypass the guard at line 789 without raising `ValueError`, failing to withhold code constructed via command substitutions.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Line or code reference: 637-639 (`elif attached_command and not attached_command.group(2).isalpha():`) and 657-660 (the `cluster_flag` check that drives the shell-command-line branch at line 660)
  PROBLEM: For alphabetic attached `-c` forms, `_segment_shape()` treats the token as a flag cluster and consumes the next positional argument as the command line.
  WHY: The resulting shape is incorrect and can expose sensitive text in the shape.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The backtick `sh -c \"echo \`mysql -p…\`\"` case moves from masked to withheld (safe side)." (PR description, review round 13 commit message)
  Expected change site: `_shell_line_credentials()` in `.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py` (line 789) and `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py`
  Evidence of absence: The function only checks `if "$(" in line` (line 789), with no check for backtick characters. The test case `("sh -c \"echo \\`mysql -pS3cretPass\\`\"", "S3cretPass", None)` in `tests/test_permission_prompts.py` (added in this PR, round 13) expects withholding, but the implementation cannot produce that outcome for backtick forms. The `$(` check does not match backticks, and `_backticks_as_substitutions` (which would convert them) runs later inside `_command_line_credentials`, after the withholding decision point.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
